import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    return (params[0]*P*np.log(P)*np.exp(-params[1]*t) + params[2]*t*np.log(t)*np.log(1+P)**2
            + params[3]*(1-np.exp(-params[4]*t))/P + params[5]*(1-np.exp(-params[6]*t)))
